summary: The note describes The Age of Reason, a work by English and American political activist Thomas Paine that argues for Deism. It places the book in the tradition of eighteenth-century British deism and notes that it challenges institutionalized religion and the legitimacy of the Bible. The work was published in three parts, in 1794, 1795, and 1807.
one_line: Thomas Paine's Deist treatise challenging institutionalized religion and the Bible, published in three parts from 1794 to 1807.
